diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_lambda_function.syncer` should wait for `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.syncer` so its execution role has the S3 permissions the function needs before the function can be invoked; the current dependency graph only orders both after the role.

`:resource.aws_lambda_function.syncer` should wait for `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_kms` when the KMS policy is configured, so the execution role has the required KMS permissions before invocation; no current dependency orders the function after this policy.

`:resource.aws_lambda_function.syncer` should wait for `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.syncer_lambda_xray` when tracing is enabled, so the execution role has the X-Ray permissions before invocation; no current dependency orders the function after this policy.

`:resource.aws_lambda_function.syncer` should wait for `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role` when VPC execution is configured, so the role has the required VPC networking permissions before the function is provisioned for VPC use.

`:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer` should depend on `:resource.aws_lambda_permission.syncer` so the EventBridge rule cannot become active with its target before invocation permission for EventBridge is installed. The target references the Lambda and rule, but not this permission.
